_comment: Caravans: each Caravan Yard level adds `caravansPerYardLevel` caravans; each carries `capacity` of resources in total and travels `speed` hexes per hour on plains (terrain move cost slows it; world speed divides time). The Holy City vault is shared by the group: level 1 holds `baseCapacity` of each resource, each level multiplies that by `capacityGrowth`; upgrades are paid from the vault itself.
